items.docs: Returns the registered post types visible to the caller. Anonymously this deployment returns 13: post, page, attachment, nav_menu_item, wp_block, wp_template, wp_template_part, wp_global_styles, wp_navigation, wp_font_family, wp_font_face, wpex_templates and wpex_card. The staff biography custom post type behind the Team page is absent — it is not REST-enabled.
